text:
sam w: Heads-up — release window blocked. Staging CI failing at artifact upload step, looks like cache service returning 503s.
deploy-bot: auto-promo paused for commit 9f2a3b (canary).
olivia: link to CI run: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/1779 — logs show repeated `PUT /cache/upload 503` from artifact-uploader.
raj: saw this earlier on eu-west runner. Is this retrying or exhausting backoff?
ci-bot: retry count=5, last_error="504 Gateway Timeout"; upload_size=42MB; upload_id=upload-73a
sam w: stacktrace snippet:
```
UploadError: failed to write part 2/5: 503 ServiceUnavailable
 at /workspace/uploader/index.js:312:14
```
marta: can someone run `kubectl get pods -n infra-cache` and check restarts? suspecting autoscaler evicting.
olivia: ran it — cache-store-0 is CrashLoopBackOff, logs show OOMKilled around 03:12 UTC, then liveness probe flapping.
dmitri: OOM on cache pod, probably memory leak from recent GC changes. Can we pin to previous image to get promos unstuck?
raj: agree. Options: 1) pin deploy to last-good image and promote manually; 2) fix cache and retry auto-promo. Timewise we have <2h in window.
sam w: decision: pin for now to avoid missing window. @deploy-bot run manual promote to tag `release/9f2a3b-pin-cache-rollout` once we have the image.
deploy-bot: ack — to avoid accidental auto-promo, I'm applying a temporary hold and will attempt manual promote when given `--manual`.
olivia: patched rollout plan: build-step create a canary image with `:pin-20260321` and add rollback hook.
marta: command to pin (example): `deploybot promote --commit 9f2a3b --image-tag pin-20260321 --force --reason "cache OOM" --manual`
ci-bot: note: upstream artifacts are still present; checksum validated: sha256:abc123...; but uploads failing due to cache write errors.
dmitri: I'll revert the GC change in staging infra and restart cache pods; ETA ~20m. After that we'll re-run the CI upload job (retry build step 5).
raj: if OOM persists after revert, fallback plan: scale cache-store to 3 replicas and enable aggressive eviction.
sam w: notify security and SRE on the decision? @oncall-sre please watch the cache cluster during manual promote.
deploy-bot: manual hold recorded: reason="CI artifact upload failures (cache OOM)"; hold_by="sam w"; released_on=none.
olivia: I'll update release notes draft to mark this as a hotfix hold and include rollback instructions.
marta: once cache is healthy I'll trigger: `ci retry 1779 --step artifact-upload --max-retries 3` and then hand off to @sam w for promote.
sam w: thanks. I'll wait for your thumbs-up. :thumbsup:
dmitri: cache pods restarted, memory pressure looks normal now. kicking off re-run.
ci-bot: rerun started, build 1780, artifact upload step running...
ci-bot: upload succeeded at 1779992798; checksum match sha256:abc123...
olivia: confirmed artifacts present in gs://redwood-staging/artifacts/9f2a3b
sam w: instructing deploy-bot to proceed with manual promote to prod: `deploybot promote --commit 9f2a3b --image-tag pin-20260321 --manual`
deploy-bot: manual promote accepted. Canaries will be 2 instances, 5-minute bake. Will post progress here.
deploy-bot: canary 1 healthy, canary 2 healthy. Rolling to remaining instances.
deploy-bot: rollout complete; release window respected. hold cleared by sam w at 1779993000.
olivia: adding postmortem note: root cause = staging cache OOM from GC change; remediation = revert GC tweak, add memory limit and alert on cache pod OOM.
sam w: closing thread — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :clap:
